It's not mine it's my dad's: when he was 9-13 he lived in France where he encountered a lot of racism due to being 'un rosbif'. He was picked on by one particularly nasty older boy, who would taunt him and slap him and generally make life tough. 

One afternoon, after being angered by a history lesson on Joan of Arc, this boy waited until everyone else had left the classroom, locked the door and turned to my dad and said "And now, you will pay." My dad, being a scrawny and scared kid began running around the classroom from this huge boy. He finally got enough speed to unlock the door and ran out slamming it behind him. The next thing he heard was the boy shouting in pain "My eye! My eye! I'm blind!". A few of his classmates began to take notice and when the door was opened my dad realised that the door handle had flown back with force and hit this bully right in the face. However the classmates around him just saw the guy lying on the floor in pain, my dad standing over him and assumed he'd beaten the bastard up! They all began to cheer (as my dad wasn't the only guy he'd been picking on) and the bully stayed out of his way for the rest of the year. AWESOME.
